name: Elven Fighter
appearance: Tall and lean with sharp, angular features and piercing emerald green eyes. He carries himself with a quiet confidence and a warrior's posture.
behavior: Reserved and watchful, Faelar rarely speaks unless necessary. He observes situations carefully before acting, preferring decisive, efficient movements.

equipment.name: Elven Longsword
equipment.description: A finely crafted blade with a leaf-shaped guard, sharp and perfectly balanced.

equipment.name: Reinforced Leather Armor
equipment.description: Light yet durable armor, allowing for swift movement while offering decent protection.

equipment.name: Wooden Shield
equipment.description: A sturdy, round shield adorned with a faded elven symbol.

equipment.name: Quiver of Arrows
equipment.description: Contains 20 standard arrows, though he primarily uses his sword.

equipment.name: Healing Potion
equipment.description: A small vial containing a shimmering red liquid, capable of mending minor wounds.
